metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises that can help get rid of hip pain at night.

Two main causes of hip pain at night comes from muscle tightness and weakness that affects us while we sleep.

This video will be broken up into to two parts to target this. To get the best results, go through both parts and use what gives you the most relief.

Watch now and fix hip pain at night!

0:00 Intro
0:43 Tightness Release 1
3:13 Tightness Release 2
5:42 Strengthening Exercise 1
